<?php
namespace BSRE\Enquiries;
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) exit;

const OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS = [
    '/off-plan-dubai-en-de/' => 'en-DE', '/off-plan-dubai-de-de/' => 'de-DE',
    '/off-plan-dubai-en-fr/' => 'en-FR', '/off-plan-dubai-fr-fr/' => 'fr-FR',
    '/off-plan-dubai-en-tw/' => 'en-TW', '/off-plan-dubai-zh-hant-tw/' => 'zh-Hant-TW',
];

function offplan_country_page_ids(): array {
    $stored = get_option('bsre_offplan_country_page_ids_v1', []);
    if (!is_array($stored) || count($stored) > count(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS)) return [];
    $ids = [];
    foreach ($stored as $path => $supplied) {
        $id = managed_native_page_id($supplied);
        if (!isset(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS[$path]) || !$id || in_array($id, [26750, 26751, 26752, 26753, 26754, 26755, 26865], true)
            || in_array($id, $ids, true)) return [];
        $ids[$path] = $id;
    }
    return $ids;
}

function offplan_country_request_scope(string $path, string $query): ?array {
    if ($path !== '/' && !isset(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS[$path])) return null;
    $preview_only = $path === '/';
    if ($preview_only) {
        if (!preg_match('/\Apage_id=([1-9][0-9]{0,19})&preview=true\z/', $query, $match)) return null;
        $path = array_search(managed_native_page_id($match[1]), offplan_country_page_ids(), true);
    }
    if (!is_string($path) || !isset(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS[$path])) return null;
    return ['kind' => 'service', 'slug' => 'off-plan', 'path' => $path,
        'country_alias' => OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS[$path], 'country_preview_only' => $preview_only];
}

function offplan_country_native_page(string $path): int {
    if (!isset(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS[$path])) return 0;
    $ids = offplan_country_page_ids();
    $id = $ids[$path] ?? 0;
    $slug = trim($path, '/');
    if (!$id || get_post_type($id) !== 'page' || get_page_template_slug($id) !== ''
        || !in_array(get_post_field('post_parent', $id, 'raw'), [0, '0'], true)
        || get_post_field('post_password', $id, 'raw') !== ''
        || get_post_field('post_name', $id, 'raw') !== $slug || get_page_uri($id) !== $slug) return 0;
    $paths = live_paths();
    return registered_service_page_id('off-plan') === 26751 && ($paths['off-plan'] ?? null) === '/enquire/off-plan/' ? $id : 0;
}

function offplan_country_public_url(string $path, int $id): string {
    if (!$id || !defined('BSRE_OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_TRANSPORT_ENABLED') || BSRE_OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_TRANSPORT_ENABLED !== true
        || get_post_status($id) !== 'publish') return '';
    return owned_parent_url(get_permalink($id), $path);
}

function offplan_country_binding(array $scope, array $held): array {
    $path = $scope['path'];
    $id = offplan_country_native_page($path);
    if (!$id || OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS[$path] !== $scope['country_alias']
        || !is_page() || managed_native_page_id(get_queried_object_id()) !== $id) return $held;
    if (is_preview()) {
        if (!in_array(get_post_status($id), ['draft', 'publish'], true) || !current_user_can('edit_post', $id)) return $held;
        return ['mode' => 'preview', 'reason' => '', 'scope' => $scope, 'id' => $id, 'canonical' => ''];
    }
    if ($scope['country_preview_only'] ?? false) return $held;
    $url = offplan_country_public_url($path, $id);
    return $url === '' ? $held : ['mode' => 'live', 'reason' => '', 'scope' => $scope, 'id' => $id, 'canonical' => $url];
}

<?php
namespace BSRE\Enquiries;
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) exit;

const OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_COOKIE = '__Host-bsre_offplan_country_session';

function offplan_country_rest_suffix(string $path, string $phase): string {
    return '/offplan-country/' . trim($path, '/') . '/' . $phase;
}

function offplan_country_csrf_salt(string $path): string {
    return hash_hmac('sha256', 'bsre-country-offplan-csrf-v1|' . $path, wp_salt('auth'));
}

function offplan_country_transport_guard(\WP_REST_Request $request, string $path, string $phase): ?\WP_REST_Response {
    if ($request->get_route() !== '/bsre/v1' . offplan_country_rest_suffix($path, $phase)
        || !ready() || offplan_country_public_url($path, offplan_country_native_page($path)) === '') return reply(503, 'NOT_CONFIGURED');
    if (!same_origin_request($request)) return reply(403, 'CSRF_FAILED');
    if (!preg_match('~^application/json(?:\s*;\s*charset=utf-8)?$~iD', (string) $request->get_header('content-type'))) return reply(415, 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE');
    return null;
}

function offplan_country_context(\WP_REST_Request $request, string $path): \WP_REST_Response {
    if ($bad = offplan_country_transport_guard($request, $path, 'context')) return $bad;
    if ($request->get_body() !== '{}') return reply(400, 'INVALID_CONTEXT');
    $ip = client_address();
    if (!$ip || limited('offplan-country-context:' . $ip, 60, 30)) return reply(429, 'RATE_LIMITED', true);
    $session = $_COOKIE[OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_COOKIE] ?? '';
    if (!is_string($session) || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D', $session)) {
        try { $session = bin2hex(random_bytes(32)); } catch (\Throwable $e) { return reply(503, 'NOT_CONFIGURED'); }
    }
    if (headers_sent() || !setcookie(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_COOKIE, $session, ['expires' => time() + 7200, 'path' => '/', 'secure' => true, 'httponly' => true, 'samesite' => 'Strict'])) return reply(503, 'NOT_CONFIGURED');
    return response(200, ['csrf_token' => csrf_token($session, time(), offplan_country_csrf_salt($path)),
        'expires_in' => 7200, 'minimum_delay_ms' => 2100, 'measurement_eligible' => false, 'measurement' => consent_denied_snapshot()]);
}

function offplan_country_receive(\WP_REST_Request $request, string $path): \WP_REST_Response {
    if ($bad = offplan_country_transport_guard($request, $path, 'lead')) return $bad;
    $raw = $request->get_body();
    if (strlen($raw) > 18000) return reply(413, 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE');
    $session = $_COOKIE[OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_COOKIE] ?? '';
    $token = (string) $request->get_header('x-bsre-csrf');
    if (!is_string($session) || !valid_csrf($token, $session, offplan_country_csrf_salt($path), time())) return reply(403, 'CSRF_FAILED');
    $ip = client_address();
    if (!$ip || limited('submit-minute:' . $ip, 60, 5) || limited('submit-hour:' . $ip, 3600, 30) || limited('submit-session:' . $session, 3600, 20)) return reply(429, 'RATE_LIMITED', true);
    if (!validate_payload($raw, home_url('/'), ['off-plan' => '/enquire/off-plan/'])) return reply(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED');
    try { $payload = consent_choice_object($raw); } catch (\Throwable $e) { return reply(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); }
    $decision = (string) $request->get_header('x-bsre-consent-decision');
    if (!in_array($decision, ['', 'none'], true) || ($payload->attribution->first ?? null) !== null
        || ($payload->attribution->last ?? null) !== null) return reply(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED');
    // Freeze an intake-only request in the same immutable receipt store. This
    // neither reads the visitor preference nor keeps any subject/click data.
    $key = substr(hash_hmac('sha256', 'bsre-offplan-country-receipt-v1|' . $path . '|' . strtolower($payload->request_id), wp_salt('auth')), 0, 32);
    $capture = consent_stage_submission($raw, consent_request_is_retry($request), null, null, $key);
    if ($capture['conflict']) return reply(409, 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT');
    if (!$capture['recorded']) return reply(503, 'ACCEPTANCE_UNCERTAIN_RETRY_SAME_ID', true);
    $row = $capture['row'];
    if (!hash_equals($key, (string) ($row['decision_version'] ?? '')) || $row['subject_key'] !== ''
        || (int) $row['known'] !== 0 || (int) $row['eligible'] !== 0) return reply(409, 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT');
    return relay_accepted_enquiry($raw, $capture, true);
}

add_action('rest_api_init', function (): void {
    foreach (OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_PATHS as $path => $locale) {

        register_rest_route('bsre/v1', offplan_country_rest_suffix($path, 'lead'), ['methods' => 'POST', 'permission_callback' => '__return_true', 'callback' => static fn ($request) => offplan_country_receive($request, $path)]);
    }
});
